verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official GitLab MCP server documented at docs.gitlab.com/user/gitlab_duo/model_context_protocol/mcp_server/. Separately, GitLab Orbit exposes MCP tools that any MCP-compatible AI agent can discover and invoke, and AI governance docs describe tool policies enforced for all connecting clients. Missing for 10: detail on setup, auth flow and the tool surface of the main MCP server, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting to it.
